name: Necessary condition

subjectOf.text: The flexibility that human business requires will unlikely ever be attained in existing decentralized protocols unless a decentralized verification system is built into decentralized commerce.
subjectOf.abstract: flexibility in existing decentralized protocols will unlikely ever be attained unless a decentralized verification system is built into decentralized commerce.

subjectOf.text: Reputation is the key ingredient that enables commerce, and it is precisely the ingredient that makes truly decentralized solutions possible.
subjectOf.abstract: In as much as reputation enables truly decentralized solutions reputation is also the key ingredient that enables commerce.

subjectOf.text: The feedback effects that make community governance of federated learning work will not materialize unless expert community members are selected coherently, making coherent expert selection a precondition of the mechanism rather than an optional refinement.
subjectOf.abstract: The key is to select the expert community members coherently to allow for the feedback effects for FL to materialize.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, How AI Models are Optimized Through Web3 Governance (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4855607
